day name: The Universal Exaltation of the Precious and Life-Giving Cross
troparia: (Tone 1) Save Your people, O Lord, and bless Your inheritance.* Grant victory to Your faithful people [to our faithful King N.] against enemies** and protect Your community by Your cross.
kontakia: (Tone 4) By Your own choice, O Christ our God,* You were lifted on the cross.* Grant Your mercies to Your new community* that bears Your Name.* By Your power gladden the faithful people,* and grant them victory against enemies.* May they have the help of Your instrument of peace,* the invincible sign of victory.
crossDismissal: , the Universal Exaltation of Which we celebrate today
